_comment: run_35 = CANDIDATE (research/age_model Phase 1): block-3 ideal-free settlement + free departure curve, single release, firm weak-Allee prior, learned juvenile kernel tail, disease as mortality, breeding-season observation; demographic priors set from House Finch biology: fecundity median 5 per adult (softplus loc 4.993, sd 0.75; ~10 fledglings/female, multi-brooded), juvenile/adult survival ratio median 0.6 (logit 0.405, sd 0.5); adult survival prior unchanged (median 0.62).

Why: E027 -- the likelihood is flat along the fecundity/survival ridge at lambda0 ~1.6 (Sa .65 / Sj .39 / F 6 costs -1 nat vs the free fit's F 8.2), so the priors set the split; the old fecundity prior (median 2.1) was arbitrary and too low for a multi-brooded finch.
